title: Locational School Dropout
description: Locational School Dropout — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Limitless Lower Locationals off Level 5 of MutantMania. Lash out against Sandy Shores and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the Limitless Lower Locationals off Level 5 of MutantMania. Lash out against Sandy Shores and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Friend, you seem distracted. Is it because you painted the canvas with the blood of my second best meal ticket? Of course, Ah'm not holding a grudge or anything. But neither am Ah holding the extra paychecks that Gertie brought in.

Let's change...Ah say, let's change topics. Have you heard of Sandy Shores? No, not the vacation spot...the MutantMania fighter.

They say Sandy Shores is one of the most brutal competitors around, but, oddly enough, he used to be a grade school teacher. Ah've scheduled you a match with him. Get to the Limitless Lower Locationals and mix it up with Mr. Shores. Ah'm sure he can teach you some pretty valuable lessons.

Turn-in:

You beat Sandy Shores, but your game still seems off. It has been ever since you trounced Grapplin' Gertie. Have Ah mentioned this before? Regardless, another vigorous workout will do you good. Come back when you're ready for another visit to Sandy Shores.

Objectives:

  • Last Out Against Sandy Shores

Client level range: 84–94
